name: The Wildos 2
review:
The bandit trio's train-heist sequel on a 4x5 grid with 20 lines. Multiplier wilds, a Wanted feature and a bonus where you choose how the story goes.

The Wanted feature and the choose-your-path bonus give it more variety than the original, and multiplier wilds are still the backbone of the base game. High volatility, 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.19%, lower than the original Wildos, so that one is better value if you mainly want the sticky wilds.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
